about.text: Forkly is a white-label ordering platform for restaurants and cafés. We give you a branded app for self-pickup orders — so you serve more people, faster, with none of the overhead of managing your own fleet.

items.question: What is Forkly?
items.answer: Forkly is a white-label ordering platform that gives your restaurant a branded app for self-pickup orders.

items.question: Is Forkly pickup-only?
items.answer: Yes. It's self-pickup only — customers order ahead and collect in store.

items.question: Do I need technical skills?
items.answer: No. You manage your menu and orders from a simple dashboard.

items.question: Can I use my own brand?
items.answer: Yes. The app uses your logo, colors, and name.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most restaurants go live within a few days.
